HomePage.title: Welcome to Dona
HomePage.description: The ultimate community platform for road event signaling. Navigate safely with real-time alerts, comments, and geo-located live chat.
HomePage.announcement: Real-Time Crowdsourced Road Alerts & AI Navigation
HomePage.heroDescription: Report hazards, verify community signals with live veracity scores, chat in location-bound channels, and let AI reroute you away from dangerous zones.
HomePage.feedPreviewSubtitle: Real-time feed in your proximity radius

features.signalingDesc: Report accidents, speed traps, and road obstacles directly from your live GPS location with media proof.
features.veracityDesc: Crowdsourced upvotes, status reactions, and official entity validations score every event from 0% to 100%.
features.reroutingDesc: Vision AI checks event photos while intelligent routing calculates safer paths around confirmed high-risk zones.
features.chatDesc: Join real-time chat channels pinned to active incident points to talk directly with nearby commuters.
